system.description:
Calls upon grasses, vines, fungi, roots, and molds to grow within and animate skeletons and corpses within 60'. These animated dead are plant-based: they are not undead, cannot be turned by clerics, and take double damage from cold-based attacks.

Animates 1 HD per caster level (e.g., 1 HD skeletons or 2 HD zombies, with standard HD, AC, and movement). They obey until destroyed, the caster dies, or dispelled via Dispel Magic.
